title: Near-to-far casts without +mos-a16 abort in the legalizer; ascast and ascast_sim lack the mos-a16-only marker
summary: examples/snes/ascast.c and examples/snes/corpus/ascast_sim.c (added in 083d8d00) cast a near pointer to address_space(2) in ac_to_far but carry no 'mos-a16-only' marker, so dev/build.sh builds them in default mode. There the #320 custom lowering of G_ADDRSPACE_CAST p0->p2 emits a 4 x s8 -> s32 G_MERGE_VALUES that is legal or custom only under hasAccum16(), and the legalizer aborts with 'unable to legalize ... G_MERGE_VALUES ... (in function: ac_to_far)' at every level -O0 to -Oz, on mosw65816 and mos6502. With -mcpu=mosw65816 +mos-a16, the flags the marker adds, both programs build on every tested toolchain; the demo's plan and gate (dev/round8d-demo.sh) already treat it as a16-only. Identical on the 0f031168 install, the 6f303945 rollback and the f24948c7 pin install, and on the #320 and far-word split tops. Upstream llvm-mos has no far address space and fails earlier, on G_LOAD p2. The repository documents default-mode far pointers as unsupported, but whether the compiler should diagnose them, keep the fatal legalizer error, or legalize the cast is undecided, hence a contract clarification rather than a defect claim.
attribution: Captured, reduced and recorded: Claude Code 2.1.295, t4-opus-high agent a4b2414005f3ae41c, model Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), high reasoning effort; session 72f6d6de-6687-477a-bb4c-b186f9d1ba7f (https://claude.ai/code/session_012Tm5osWxSMUvv28Uw7nudx). The original sighting (preexisting-demo-build-failures.log) belongs to the 2026-10-01 soft-stack link-reserve work; see that record for its attribution.
unknowns: The intended default-mode contract for address_space(2) (diagnostic, fatal legalizer error, or legal lowering) is not decided; it is a #320 design question for the user and upstream review.
The pre-0071 clang-23 254624ba toolchain of the original log is not on disk; its leg is retained only as that log.

patches/llvm-mos/0002-321-accum16.patch (G_MERGE_VALUES s32 rules gated on hasAccum16)
prior_work.source_assessment: vendor/llvm-mos-0f031168a7cc MOSLegalizerInfo.cpp: G_ADDRSPACE_CAST is customForCartesianProduct({P, PZ, PF, PFP}) in all modes; G_MERGE_VALUES {S32,S16} is legal and {S32,S8} custom only when STI.hasAccum16(), otherwise unsupported.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Every tested binary (llc a78958b0..., 6f303945..., f68dae29...; split r7-320-4 and r7-fw-12) fails on ac_to_far in default mode and passes with +mos-a16; r7-321-16, p-321-00 and /opt/llvm-mos (no #320) fail earlier on G_LOAD p2 in ac_read.
prior_work.decision: New record for an unowned, documented limit. mos-far-pointer-arg-exhaustion mentions the same plain-mode s32 merge failure only as a side observation of a calling-convention defect (fixed), and mos-far-access-non-65816 is about far opcodes on non-65816 CPUs (fixed); neither owns default-mode far casts. The battery failure itself is a missing demo marker, not a compiler regression.

configuration.expected: the object compiles, or a diagnostic names the missing +mos-a16
